parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the principle of conservation of momentum.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
A ball X has mass $240\text{ g}$ and moves in a straight line on a horizontal frictionless surface with an initial speed of $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The ball collides with a stationary ball Y that has mass $480\text{ g}$. After the collision, ball X is stationary, as shown in Fig. 2.1.
{{figure:figure_2_1.png}}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Show that the speed $v$ of ball Y after the collision is $8.0\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the change in the total kinetic energy $\Delta E_{\text{K}}$ of the balls due to the collision.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: The collision in (b) lasts for a time of $2.0\text{ ms}$. Assume that the contact force between the balls is constant during this time.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude and direction of the force exerted on ball X by ball Y during the collision.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Compare the magnitude and direction of the force exerted on ball Y by ball X during the collision with the answers in (c)(i). No further calculations are required.
